newsitem.title: USA: Wicklund moving ahead on acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Wicklund moving ahead on acquisition.

text.p: Wicklund Holding Co and International Plastics Corp said Friday the two companies reached terms and signed a letter of intent for the reverse acquisition of International Plastics, which is expected to be completed in February.
Under preliminary terms, announced in early December, Wicklund would effect a reverse split, converting its five million shares into 3.9 million shares, in order to make the acquisition.
Nicholasville, Ky.-based International Plastics, a recycler of proprietary plastic materials, will be the surviving company. Wicklund is engaged in the oil and gas pumping business.
